visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fact cards with a heading label, an oversized stat value (a paragraph, not a heading), a short description and a square photo below.
visualCharacteristics.description: Thin grey top rule, serif bold 24px label, very large serif stat (76px) with a light-to-dark blue text gradient, 20px description, square rounded photo at the bottom. Stacked on mobile, text beside photo per card on tablet, cards side by side (three-column track, centered) on desktop.

contentPattern.structure: One row per card, two cells: Image | H3 label, stat paragraph (e.g. '$100M'), description paragraph.
contentPattern.description: Repeating fact cards. The first paragraph after the heading is styled as the stat; it stays a paragraph so the heading outline is not polluted. The image renders after the text whatever the cell order.
contentPattern.blockContent: Two fact cards: 'Belonging' $100M and 'Greenhouse gas reduction' 50%, each with a description and a square photo
table: H3 label, stat paragraph, description paragraph
H3 label, stat paragraph, description paragraph

usage.description: Fact cards with a big stat value.

reuseGuidance: Use for key figures (amounts, percentages) each with a label, a sentence and a photo. One row per card: image | H3, stat paragraph, description.
